newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA- BIRZAI DAIRY SEES 12-14 MILLION LITAS PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA- BIRZAI DAIRY SEES 12-14 MILLION LITAS PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzai dairy said on Thursday that it expected its 1997 net profit to soar to 12 to 14 million litas versus 1.9 million litas last year.
"We anticipate our 1997 net profit to be 12 to 14 million litas," the company's general director Vladas Songaila told Reuters by telephone.
The company's unaudited results for 1996 show a net profit of 1.9 million litas versus 3.8 million litas in 1995.
Songaila said that the audited results, due out next week, would be almost the same.
Songaila said that the he based the forecast on the company's plans to upgrade its production lines.
The upgrading will be funded with the 1996 profits and with the capital raised by the company's $6.0 million Global depository receipts (GDR) issue of last year.
Birzai is one of the leading blue chip stocks on Lithuania's bourse.
